purpose: Frozen synthetic source-level observations; not a danger-screening benchmark, clinician assessment, or release qualification.

cases.message: My friend is standing on a rooftop ledge and says goodbye.
cases.reason: Plausible active danger is not recognized by either lexical router.

cases.message: My coworker took a bunch of pills and passed out.
cases.reason: Unresponsive third-party ingestion is not represented by these literal word patterns.

cases.message: I found a person unconscious with empty medication bottles.
cases.reason: Neither router recognizes this third-party medical emergency paraphrase.
Known browser-vs-Python disagreement on recent bleach ingestion.

cases.message: In my novel I just drank antifreeze, not in real life.
cases.reason: The browser router treats an explicitly fictional statement as urgent.

cases.message: My spouse has a loaded gun aimed at me tonight.
cases.reason: Neither lexical router recognizes this present weapon threat.

cases.message: My daughter accidentally drank antifreeze 10 minutes ago.
cases.reason: A third-party recent toxic ingestion is not recognized.

cases.message: My partner put a knife against my throat right now.
cases.reason: Browser has a narrow guard while the Python safety router may diverge.

cases.message: I swallowed a cup of antifreeze 20 minutes ago.
cases.reason: An explicit browser toxicity guard is absent from the Python route.

cases.message: I am going to kill myself tonight.
cases.reason: An explicit current-intent wording triggers both rule sets; this does not establish sensitivity.

cases.message: I am not planning to hurt myself. I understand why despair can feel unbearable.
cases.reason: False positive: one router treats explicit denial as concern, the other as immediate. This must not be presented as detected intent.

cases.message: My manager expects me to buy gas for the company truck and I need options.
cases.reason: Ordinary workplace decision is not treated as a crisis cue.

cases.message: I want to talk about how to set boundaries with my family.
cases.reason: Ordinary relationship question is not treated as a crisis cue.
